Definition: Extent to which the data exchange enables services accessible to all population groups including persons with disabilities, elderly, low literacy
Comments: Internet penetration 59.7% (2023, ARPCE). 5.9 million mobile subscribers. World Bank project aims to increase broadband to underserved populations. Rural connectivity remains limited. Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: Personal Data Protection Law NÂ° 29-2019 (Oct 2019, entered force Nov 2020) exists. It provides data processing rules. Comments: Significant urban-rural divide. World Bank PATN project explicitly aims to provide high-speed internet to underserved rural populations.
